title: Cape Cod
html:
Cape Cod is a North American map added to OpenFront in Update 34.0 by truffle383-byte — the hook-shaped Massachusetts cape with Martha’s Vineyard and Nantucket offshore.

Nations

The map features 31 named nations, including Plymouth, Falmouth, Martha’s Vineyard, Nantucket, Provincetown and Bridgewater.

Details

  • Categories: North America, New
  • Nations: 31
  • Public rotation frequency: 4
